title: 'This one is a corker and probably the finest of its ilk for many years'
summary: James Cracknell reads Incorruptible as the fulfillment of the Long-Term Stock Exchange ambition Eric spelled out at the end of The Lean Startup — and calls it 'a blueprint, not a manifesto' for civic infrastructure against short-termism.
blockquote: Having read many business books, this one is a corker and probably the finest of its ilk for many years.
